subject: Bogart Update
author: The Kid 74
body: It may be just me, but I have noticed more traffic since the update. Drifting is more controllable too. Also, the crashes are more defined with better views. Keep on adding more enhancements!!!

subject: It's been fine for me. No
author: Mohegan
body: It's been fine for me. No issues at all. At least no new ones.

subject: Other Bogart issues
author: Gooner Rhyle
body: I noticed the extra traffic as well. Another thing I was getting was trouble in the junk yard. When selecting a new car it sometimes wouldn't let me scroll right or even select a new car, I had to leave with the car I entered with, re-enter and try to select again. No problem since Bogart was removed though.
